title.zh-CN: 图库素材迁移与发品回读

summary.zh-CN: 图库支持 ZIP 导入导出，Web/BFF 与插件均支持 S3 目录映射，并完善任务恢复、分组回填和失败提示。
summary.en-US: Transfer gallery assets as ZIPs, map S3 folders in Web/BFF and the extension, and improve task recovery, group hierarchy and failure guidance.

title.zh-CN: 图库 ZIP 导入导出

description.zh-CN: Web 与插件可下载原图及校验清单，或导入最多 50 MiB 的图库 ZIP；确认后才上传。
description.en-US: Web and extension users can export originals with a verified manifest or import gallery ZIPs up to 50 MiB. Uploads require confirmation.

title.zh-CN: S3 目录映射与插件直连
title.en-US: S3 folder mapping and direct extension access

description.zh-CN: 加密保存 S3 配置，按前缀规则或指定图库分组导入，可选自动创建三级以内目录。插件可独立直连，无需部署后端；传输时需保持工作台打开。
description.en-US: Store S3 configuration encrypted and import using prefix rules or one gallery group, with optional creation of up to three folder levels. The extension connects directly without a backend; keep the workbench open during transfers.

description.zh-CN: 保留批量任务恢复状态，结合平台回读确认发品结果，并提供已验证的商品详情链接。
description.en-US: Retain batch recovery state, verify publishing results by reading them back from Alibaba, and expose verified product detail links.

description.zh-CN: 修正图库子目录层级映射，保留部分成功提示；上传结果不明时提示平台核对，关闭弹窗后丢弃旧预览。
description.en-US: Correct nested gallery group mapping, preserve partial-success feedback, require platform checks after uncertain uploads, and discard stale previews after closing dialogs.

title.zh-CN: 插件商品更新与分组新增
title.en-US: Extension product updates and group creation

summary.zh-CN: 插件现在可以安全地增量更新现存商品并新增商品分组，使用持久任务、受信页面指纹和平台回读避免重复或未确认的真实写入。
summary.en-US: The extension can now safely update existing products incrementally and create product groups, using durable jobs, trusted-page fingerprints, and platform read-back to prevent duplicate or unverified real writes.

title.zh-CN: 现存商品安全增量更新

description.zh-CN: 开放插件中的商品更新能力，仅提交实际变化字段，并在 Alibaba 审核结束后通过 Schema 字段指纹回读确认结果。
description.en-US: Enables product updates in the extension, submits only changed fields, and verifies the result with Schema field fingerprints after Alibaba review completes.

description.zh-CN: 商品分组树可以在平台限制范围内新增根分组或子分组，并在成功后刷新真实分组结构。
description.en-US: The product group tree can create root or child groups within platform limits and refresh the real group hierarchy after success.

description.zh-CN: 更新状态保存在本机，重复写入会被拦截；XML 只在受信工作台解析，service worker 仅校验哈希和回读结果。
description.en-US: Update state is persisted locally and duplicate writes are blocked; XML is parsed only in the trusted workspace while the service worker validates hashes and read-back results.

title.zh-CN: 审核状态与本地验证更稳定
title.en-US: More reliable review state and local verification

description.zh-CN: 兼容平台包装后的审核中错误码，并在本地验证前刷新 unpacked 扩展，避免旧 service worker 缓存造成误判。
description.en-US: Recognizes wrapped platform review codes and reloads the unpacked extension before local verification to avoid stale service-worker results.

description.zh-CN: 登录过期时弹窗引导重新登录；空闲期限延长到 4 小时，最长 24 小时。
description.en-US: A dialog guides sign-in after expiry. Sessions now allow 4 idle hours, up to 24 hours total.

summary.zh-CN: 在首次引导、凭证入口、商店说明和隐私政策中明确 oneVegetable 与 Alibaba.com 无官方关联，并提供官方平台规则入口。
summary.en-US: Clarifies across onboarding, credential entry points, the store listing, and privacy policy that oneVegetable has no official affiliation with Alibaba.com, with direct access to official platform rules.

title.en-US: Bilingual notice at key entry points

description.zh-CN: 首次使用、插件与云端凭证向导、扩展设置和自托管管理页现在都会说明本工具独立开发，且不存在官方隶属、合作、认可或背书关系。
description.en-US: First use, extension and cloud credential assistants, extension settings, and self-hosted administration now explain that the tool is independently developed and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially associated with Alibaba.com.

title.zh-CN: 官方规则入口与发布守卫
title.en-US: Official rules link and release guard

description.zh-CN: 声明可直达 Alibaba.com 官方规则中心，商店合规检查会验证双语声明没有在后续版本中意外丢失。
description.en-US: The notice links directly to the official Alibaba.com rules center, and store compliance checks prevent either localized disclosure from being removed accidentally.

title.zh-CN: 开放平台授权新手引导

summary.zh-CN: 为 Chrome 插件和自托管工作台增加四步图文首次引导，识别开发者注册、平台审核和应用准备状态，并衔接现有 OAuth 凭证获取流程。
summary.en-US: Adds a four-step visual first-use journey for the Chrome extension and self-hosted workspace, detects developer registration, review, and application readiness, and continues into the existing OAuth credential flow.

description.zh-CN: 插件和自托管管理员首次使用时可查看注册、审核、应用配置与 OAuth 四步说明，并直接进入对应的授权向导。
description.en-US: Extension users and self-hosted administrators now see four illustrated steps covering registration, review, application setup, and OAuth before entering the appropriate authorization assistant.

description.zh-CN: 能够区分待注册、审核中、审核退回、缺少应用和应用未就绪状态，提供下一步指引并避免无意义的持续等待。
description.en-US: Distinguishes registration required, under review, rejected, missing application, and application not ready states, with actionable guidance instead of indefinite waiting.

description.zh-CN: 仅在用户主动启动向导后显示 Alibaba 页面提示，不读取注册资料值、不代为提交协议，也不尝试绕过验证码或风控。
description.en-US: Shows Alibaba page guidance only after a user starts the assistant, without reading registration values, accepting agreements, submitting forms, or bypassing verification challenges.

summary.zh-CN: 统一商店文案、首次引导和内置隐私页中的真实写能力说明，准确披露已经验收的平台草稿、正式发品与商品上下架。
summary.en-US: Aligns the store copy, onboarding, and bundled privacy pages with the verified platform draft, product publishing, and product display capabilities.

title.zh-CN: 真实写能力说明保持一致

description.zh-CN: 商店资料和首次引导不再把已开放的平台草稿与正式发品误写为关闭状态。
description.en-US: Store materials and onboarding no longer describe the verified platform draft and product publishing paths as disabled.

description.zh-CN: 中英文隐私页明确区分已验收写能力和仍在后台阻断的未验收操作。
description.en-US: The Chinese and English privacy pages now distinguish verified writes from unvalidated operations that remain blocked in the background.

title.zh-CN: 双语工作台与社交发布

summary.zh-CN: 加入完整中英文界面、受控的 Facebook/Instagram 单图发布、扩展真实发品闭环，以及更清晰的反馈与日常运营体验。
summary.en-US: Adds a complete Chinese and English interface, guarded Facebook and Instagram single-image publishing, verified extension product creation, and clearer feedback and daily operations.

description.zh-CN: 工作台、登录、弹窗、提示和扩展 Popup 均可即时切换中英文，且界面语言与 Alibaba 接口语言保持独立。
description.en-US: Switches the workspace, authentication, dialogs, notices, and extension popup between Chinese and English without coupling the UI locale to the Alibaba API language.

description.zh-CN: 支持连接用户自己的 Meta 应用和自托管后端，把一张图库图片经二次确认发布到 Facebook Page 或 Instagram 专业账号，并按需查询帖子链接。
description.en-US: Connects the user's own Meta app and self-hosted backend to publish one confirmed gallery image to a Facebook Page or Instagram professional account and retrieve its post link on demand.

title.zh-CN: 插件真实发品安全闭环
title.en-US: Guarded real product creation in the extension

description.zh-CN: 开放已验证的平台草稿、正式发品和商品上下架能力，使用持久任务、指纹去重、错误保留和平台回读避免重复写入。
description.en-US: Enables verified platform drafts, product publishing, and product display changes with persistent jobs, fingerprint deduplication, retained errors, and platform read-back checks.

title.zh-CN: 商品与图库操作更高效
title.en-US: More efficient product and gallery workflows

description.zh-CN: 发品预检更多采用非阻断提示，优化平台错误展示、整数数量价格、图库列表视图、日期时间格式和常用操作布局。
description.en-US: Makes more product preflight findings advisory, improves platform error details, integer quantity prices, the gallery list view, date and time formatting, and common action layouts.

description.zh-CN: 可在本机脱敏预览截图后前往 GitHub 提交反馈，并在使用满七天后以克制频率邀请用户前往 Chrome 应用商店评价。
description.en-US: Lets users preview a locally redacted screenshot before opening a GitHub feedback form and offers a restrained Chrome Web Store review reminder after seven days of use.

description.zh-CN: 简化身份与状态信息，增加本地待办、RFQ 官网指引、版本更新页及更稳定的弹窗和无障碍交互。
description.en-US: Simplifies identity and status chrome while adding local todos, official RFQ guidance, release notes, and more reliable dialogs and accessible interactions.

title.zh-CN: 凭据连接与商品 ZIP 迁移
title.en-US: Credential connections and product ZIP migration

summary.zh-CN: 完善 Alibaba 开放平台凭据获取路径，并让商品资料及关联图片可以通过 ZIP 安全迁移。
summary.en-US: Improves Alibaba Open Platform credential acquisition and enables safe ZIP migration of product data and linked images.

description.zh-CN: 新增本机、Chrome 插件与自托管管理端的凭据获取流程，并在遇到验证码或安全确认时提供人工续接路径。
description.en-US: Adds credential acquisition for local Node, the Chrome extension, and self-hosted administration, with a manual continuation path for CAPTCHA or security confirmation.

title.zh-CN: 商品 ZIP 导入导出

description.zh-CN: 支持将商品 JSON 与 assets 图片目录一起迁移，导入时可识别相对路径并上传到图库。
description.en-US: Moves product JSON together with an assets image directory, resolves relative paths during import, and uploads those assets to the gallery.

description.zh-CN: 补充商品资产下载契约、图库域名重定向校验和独立归档处理，降低大文件阻塞主界面的风险。
description.en-US: Adds product asset download contracts, gallery redirect validation, and isolated archive processing to reduce the risk of large files blocking the main interface.

title.zh-CN: 修复资源识别与 CDN 兼容问题
title.en-US: Asset detection and CDN compatibility fixes

description.zh-CN: 修复导入文件类型识别和部分 Alibaba CDN 图片变体不可用的问题。
description.en-US: Fixes imported file type detection and unsupported Alibaba CDN image variants.

title.zh-CN: 商品详情模板与弹窗稳定性
title.en-US: Product description templates and dialog stability

summary.zh-CN: 集中修复商品详情模板保存及复杂弹窗重复打开时的交互问题。
summary.en-US: Focuses on product description template persistence and repeated interactions with complex dialogs.

description.zh-CN: 避免详情模板替换或保存过程中出现一半完成、一半仍在刷新的状态。
description.en-US: Prevents mixed states where part of a template replacement or save is complete while another part is still refreshing.

description.zh-CN: 修复关闭后立即重开、控件重新挂载和动画期间重复操作引起的状态错乱。
description.en-US: Fixes state corruption caused by immediate reopen, control remounting, and repeated actions during transitions.

description.zh-CN: 刷新或提交过程中锁定相关模板操作，减少误触和重复提交。
description.en-US: Locks related template actions during refresh or submission to reduce accidental and duplicate actions.

summary.zh-CN: 完成 Vue 3、Manifest V3、类型化契约和双运行时后端的第一版正式工程化交付。
summary.en-US: Delivers the first stable engineering baseline with Vue 3, Manifest V3, typed contracts, and a dual-runtime backend.

title.zh-CN: Vue 3 与 Manifest V3 工作台

description.zh-CN: 以 pnpm workspace 重建 Web、Chrome 插件、共享 core 和 UI，并提供商品、图库、RFQ、订单、物流及能力目录。
description.en-US: Rebuilds the Web app, Chrome extension, shared core, and UI as a pnpm workspace with products, gallery, RFQs, orders, logistics, and a capability catalog.

title.zh-CN: 真实商品发布与批量流程
title.en-US: Real product publishing and batch workflows

description.zh-CN: 接入 Schema 发品、平台草稿、商品更新、批量发布及真实调用的安全开关和回读验证。
description.en-US: Adds Schema publishing, platform drafts, product updates, batch publishing, safety switches for real calls, and read-back validation.

title.zh-CN: JSON 商品迁移与分组管理
title.en-US: JSON product migration and group management

description.zh-CN: 支持 Schema JSON/XML 字段兼容的 JSON 导入导出，并提供商品和图库的树形分组体验。
description.en-US: Supports JSON import and export with Schema JSON/XML field compatibility and tree-based product and gallery group management.

description.zh-CN: 提供 Worker、静态 Web 与 D1 的同源部署，加入 Passkey、加密凭据和管理员安全控制。
description.en-US: Deploys the Worker, static Web app, and D1 on one origin with passkeys, encrypted credentials, and administrator security controls.

description.zh-CN: 统一 requestId、契约校验、操作可用性和脱敏诊断，避免真实模式静默回退到 Mock。
description.en-US: Unifies request IDs, contract validation, operation availability, and redacted diagnostics so real mode never silently falls back to Mock.
